Application Data.NAME: Smith & Associates Accounting Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Associates Accounting Solutions provides comprehensive accounting and financial services, including bookkeeping, tax preparation, financial planning, and investment advisory. Our team specializes in personalized service for small to medium-sized businesses, focusing on tailored financial strategies and compliance with regulatory standards. We prioritize data security with robust cybersecurity measures, including data encryption and regular employee training on best practices. Our firm does not utilize cloud-based accounting software, ensuring complete control over our clients' sensitive information. We maintain a strong commitment to risk management and professional liability coverage, safeguarding our clients' interests through stringent operational protocols and a thorough claims history review.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• Business Operations: Confirm the exact nature of services provided. Firms engaged solely
in bookkeeping or tax preparation may have different risk profiles than those offering invest-
ment advice or financial planning.
• Professional Liability Coverage: Verify whether the applicant maintains separate pro-
fessional liability insurance. Absence of such coverage should prompt referral to a specialty
underwriter or require additional risk mitigation measures.
• Data Security Measures: Assess the firm’s cybersecurity protocols, including data en-
cryption, employee training, and backup systems. Strong controls reduce the likelihood and
impact of cyber incidents.
• Premises and Equipment Values: Ensure accurate valuation of office contents and prop-
erty to avoid underinsurance.
• Claims History: Review prior claims related to errors, omissions, data breaches, or general
liability incidents.
